enGuide: The previous full story ending has completed. After the (source-documented) no-choice CG epilogue, select title-menu 「既視感」 to begin another complete playthrough. This is an actual replay boundary, NOT a normal four-day continuation. Set A prints this before the second/third complete run. If you are here as a fallback because the TRUE option did not appear, follow this sequence from a fresh run after the ending you could select; don't pretend that TRUE has been cleared.

jpGuide1: 「既視感」から「記憶を失う」後、開始
enGuide: Choose 「記憶を失う」 to wipe current run progression/saves and begin from the opening; the official patched-2002 notice says gallery/scene records survive, but 2015 Selection-specific parity remains untested. Do not use a save made before this reset. For eventual 100% CG, keep Config 「盲点」 ON through any full repeat run if it was OFF previously.
